title: Cross Axis Alignment 📐
description: Align items vertically (or horizontally) with `align-items` and `align-content`.

slides.title: `align-items`: Alignment on the Cross Axis 🎯
slides.content:
# Control All Items at Once

`align-items` sets the default alignment for all flex items along the cross axis. Values:
- `stretch` (default) – items stretch to fill the container's cross size (unless they have an intrinsic size).
- `flex-start` / `start` – packed at the start of the cross axis.
- `flex-end` / `end` – packed at the end.
- `center` – centred.
- `baseline` – aligned by their text baselines.

```css
.container {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center; /* vertical centring in a row layout */
}
```

quizData.question: What does `align-items: stretch;` do?

options.text: Makes all items the same height as the tallest item (if flex-direction is row)

quizData.explanation: `stretch` (default) makes items fill the cross axis, giving equal height columns in a row layout.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Use `gap` for Gutters

The `gap` property (row‑gap, column‑gap) sets consistent spacing between flex items without extra margins. Combine with alignment for clean layouts.
